entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dnx: Ambiguities between tool command arguments and dnx arguments #51067
  • Ensure CLI Telemetry Logger is hooked up to all API-based MSbuild usage #51066
  • LocalUserSecrets project capability not present when project references ASP.NETCore framework without WebSDK #51065
  • Cannot build file-based libraries #51064
    10.0.1xx
  • Update shell completion scripts to use new 'dotnet completions' command. #51062
  • Feature: add manpage support to dotnet tools #51061
  • .NET 10 RC1 SDK produces erroneous NU1902 and NU1903 warnings when restoring multi-targeted packages #51060
  • WASM Hot Reload: Add support for auto-restart on runtime rude edit #51056

Closed

  • [DevExE2E][Regression] The 8.0/9.0 implicit runtime(8.0.20/9.0.9) is not the same with VS carries(8.0.21/9.0.10) in the RC2 insertion PR build. #51046

    Servicing-consider
